ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI(s), comma-separated if multiple (e.g., primary and backup)

ldap_binddn.description: DN to bind as for initial search (if LDAP_INITBIND=1)

ldap_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for LDAP operations

ldap_mail.description: LDAP attribute used for user lookup

ldap_homedir.description: LDAP attribute containing user's home directory

ldap_maildir.description: LDAP attribute containing maildir path (if not default)

ldap_defaultdelivery.description: LDAP attribute for per-account mail delivery instructions

ldap_fullname.description: LDAP attribute for user's full name

ldap_clearpw.description: LDAP attribute for clear-text password (for CRAM-MD5)

ldap_deref.description: Alias dereferencing behavior (never, searching, finding, always)
